{"action":"done","summary":"All 227 tests pass (4 acceptance_public + 223 upstream). The existing tinydb/journal.py implementation already correctly satisfies all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply(operations) accepts insert/remove dicts, returns inserted IDs, raises ValueError on malformed ops
- R02: Atomic batch with full rollback on any error (deepcopy storage, restore on failure)
- R03: Ordinary TinyDB ops work, deep copies prevent aliasing of documents
- R04: bool rejected as doc_id, structural validation, empty dicts accepted, unsupported fields raise ValueError
- R05: preview() returns predicted IDs without modifying data or consuming IDs; failed apply doesn't consume IDs
- R06: No stale snapshot - reads fresh storage each time, direct inserts are visible
- R07: Idempotency token support - same token+ops returns cached result, different ops raises ValueError, failed batches don't consume tokens
- R08: Token bookkeeping internal to BatchWriter, preview doesn't consume tokens

No code changes were needed - the implementation was already correct."}
